html:
SMTO-EXE-0081 — The computer sent back a clipboard answer SMTO couldn't trust

GUID: f9429169-4917-54cc-9abc-bb268761de6a
Slug: clipboard-invalid-response
Domain: EXE · Subsystem: clipboard

What happened

  • SMTO asked the Gateway to read its clipboard, but the answer that came back was damaged, too large or incomplete, so SMTO ignored it. Reading never changes the clipboard.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Settings › Setup › Gateways and select Check for updates, then install any Gateway update it offers. A Gateway on a different version from SMTO can send clipboard answers in a form SMTO rejects.
  2. Ask SMTO to read the clipboard again. Reading doesn't change the clipboard, so asking again can't cause harm.

What success looks like

  • SMTO shows the clipboard result, such as the text or file list, without an error.

If it still fails

  • This is probably a bug. Select Copy error details and send them to the person who installed SMTO, saying whether the Gateway computer runs Windows, macOS or Linux. Don't include clipboard contents in the report.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • A clipboard read or inspect result from the selected Gateway failed ClipboardResponse validation, the isolated clipboard worker exited unsuccessfully or returned an oversized envelope, or the Server could not parse the receipt.

What this means

  • The clipboard result failed its typed field/content contract, the worker returned an unsuccessful exit or oversized envelope, or the transport could not validate a read receipt. These operations address the selected Gateway desktop. Metadata discovery does not authorize content reads, and a native control request is not proof of completed effects; retain exact operation and target identities.

Why this can happen

  • The clipboard result failed its typed field/content contract, the worker returned an unsuccessful exit or oversized envelope, or the transport could not validate a read receipt.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the original operation type and failed receipt contract; preserve unknown-write classification when effects are possible.

How to fix it

  • Report it as a bug with the execution_id. Check Server/Gateway version compatibility for the clipboard contract (validate_response in src/gateway_core/clipboard_contract.py) and, on Windows/macOS, whether gateway_core.clipboard_worker exits non-zero; update only the incompatible component. This kind is only returned for read operations (an invalid receipt for a write or clear is reported as clipboard_outcome_unknown), and completion must never be inferred from the invalid receipt.
  • Inspect the failing receipt and controller/Gateway compatibility. Reconcile any potentially changed clipboard before another write; repair or update only the identified incompatible component.

Retry and execution caution

  • Refresh or upgrade the selected Gateway. Do not infer completion from an invalid receipt.

How to verify the fix

  • The original request is settled and future responses satisfy the matching protocol without inferring completion from malformed data.

What not to do

  • Never automatically replay an uncertain clipboard write or include content in diagnostics.

Technical notes

  • These operations address the selected Gateway desktop. Metadata discovery does not authorize content reads, and a native control request is not proof of completed effects; retain exact operation and target identities.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
